description: The medicinal product Helixor is supplied as a film-coated tablet containing the active substance paracetamol at a strength of 500 mg. It is given by the oral route. The marketing authorization holder is Helix Therapeutics Ltd.

The medicinal product Amoxen is supplied as a capsule containing the active substance amoxicillin at a strength of 250 mg. It is given by the oral route. The marketing authorization holder is Northwind Pharmaceuticals.

The medicinal product Ventiva is supplied as a pressurised inhalation containing the active substance salbutamol at a strength of 100 mcg. It is given by the inhalation route. The marketing authorization holder is AeroMed AG.

The medicinal product Ondexa is supplied as a solution containing the active substance ondansetron at a strength of 4 mg. It is given by the intravenous route. The marketing authorization holder is Harbor Clinical Supply, Basel.

The medicinal product Dermacort is supplied as a cream containing the active substance hydrocortisone at a strength of 1 %. It is given by the topical route. The marketing authorization holder is Dermora Laboratories.
Warehouse note: the carton label is missing and the batch record does not identify the substance, strength, dose form, route, or holder.
